title: Polish Sausage Roast
description: A hearty and flavorful roast featuring Polish sausages, perfect for a cold winter's night. This dish is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.
instructions: Place the roast in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot.
Add the Polish sausages to the pot.
Toss the potatoes and carrots in a bowl with 1 tbsp of polish and add to the pot.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover the pot with a lid and roast in the preheated oven for 1 hour.
Remove the lid and continue roasting for an additional 30 minutes.
Check the sausages for internal temperature (160°F / 71°C).
